evals.prompt: Add a localized managed slug sourced from title with a synchronized lock and Unicode/Persian normalization.

evals.prompt: Preserve a custom previous slug when a nested source changes to empty string, null, or undefined, while regeneration remains enabled.
evals.expected_output: A path-presence-aware hook that treats explicit clears as clears and preserves the exact prior slug.
expectations: Distinguishes an absent source path from an explicitly null/undefined value.
Preserves the custom previous slug for all clear variants.
Tests dot-path and regeneration behavior through the real hook.

evals.prompt: Review a server slug generator that exposes API keys to clientProps, trusts generator=toString, skips access control, accepts null bodies, and returns raw exceptions.
evals.expected_output: A fail-closed registered-generator design with server-only secrets, own-key lookup, structured validation, access, and error suppression.
expectations: Keeps callback/secrets server-side and sends only the generator key.
Requires auth then explicit access and own-property registry lookup.
Normalizes null/invalid input and generator failures.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why a nested slug lock toggles correctly but the generator reads the wrong title, and why an unlocked manual slug still changes.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded explanation of sibling-relative lock paths, supplied global source paths, and final manual normalization.
expectations: Distinguishes lock path resolution from getDataByPath(source).
Requires an explicit nested source path and Admin test.
Explains that unlocked strings remain subject to formatSlug.

evals.prompt: Guarantee globally unique SEO slugs, reserved-word rejection, collision suffixing, and redirects for historical slugs.
evals.expected_output: A scope boundary that treats database uniqueness/routing/history as application architecture beyond package normalization.
expectations: Does not claim slugField implements uniqueness or redirects.
Retains formatSlug only as final normalization where useful.
Requests application persistence/routing requirements before expanding scope.
